function: Excluded (no_learning): PT beamforming and BackCom tag reflection coefficients come from a classical alternating optimization (Dinkelbach, WMMSE, dual decomposition); the only ML-labelled step is mean-shift receiver clustering (p. 2, p. 4).
notes: Reason no_learning: the physical-layer function (EE-maximizing beamforming and reflection coefficients) is solved by classical optimization. p. 2: "an ML-based modified mean shift clustering for the PR clustering and an alternating optimization (AO) algorithm after the PR clustering to maximize the EE"; p. 4: "Problem (6) is solved using the dual decomposition approach". The mean-shift step is an untrained iterative clustering (p. 4: "O(Ia KN), where {Ia, N, K} are the number of {iterations") that only groups receivers into NOMA clusters; if the reviewer counts it as learning, it acts above the PHY (user grouping) and above_phy would apply instead. No RIS (p. 3, footnote 1). Page 1 is a HAL cover page; the letter starts on p. 2. PDF title and authors match the DOI (Crossref).
